faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Silchar is 15-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a relevant/allied discipline with a minimum of 60% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Silchar JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with bio-data and required documents and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post announced by NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Silchar is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" description.
